citation: Sandhu N, Singh J, Ankush AP, Augustine G, Raigar OP, Verma VK, Pruthi G, Kumar A. Development of novel KASP markers for improved germination in deep-sown direct seeded rice
what_it_anchors: per-marker KASP genotype-CALL error rates (false positive and false negative) on progeny
claim: Across 54 trait-linked KASP markers the printed rates span 0.55-11.8% (NILs FPR), 1.14-12.86% (NILs FNR) and 0-9.52% (RILs FNR); the medians are 5.5%, 5.2% and 4.2%, and 6 of the 54 markers exceed 10% on at least one rate
claim_kind: measured per-marker call error rate; clustering error on real populations, not a mismatch efficiency
